correctness.rationale: PASS: The free positive occupation fraction is a ratio of two independent positive mu-stable variables, yielding E[(a(1-V)+bV)^(-1)]=(a^(mu-1)+b^(mu-1))/(a^mu+b^mu). Conditioning on the first independent Poisson reset gives M_k(t)=e^(-rt)g_k(t)+r(e^(-r.)g_k)*M_k and Laplace denominator 1-rG_k(r+s). The unique real pole has r+psi>max(0,k) because the Stieltjes function strictly decreases from infinity at the endpoint to zero. Exponential tilting of its finite-mean, nonlattice renewal kernel gives the growth exponent psi(k), analytic strictly convex by the positive tilted-excursion variance. Gärtner–Ellis plus compact support gives the full LDP with boundary limits by continuity from interior. The q=(r+psi-k)/(r+psi) substitution gives the displayed parametric formulas; expansion q->0 proves I(eps)=r-[r/mu](mu/(1-mu))^(1-mu)eps^mu+o(eps^mu). The mu=1/2 boundary recovers the known Brownian rate. Independent high-precision Stieltjes/pole/quadratic-core calculations checked mu=.25,.4,.5. These numerical checks do not replace the infinite-time renewal proof.

value.rationale: PASS: The exact non-Gaussian rate and fractional endpoint exponent quantify exponentially rare occupation imbalance in the recently studied sluggish reset model. They sharpen a Gaussian central-limit core to an entire constrained large-deviation law and precisely isolate a physically meaningful dynamical parameter mu; this is a motivated missing statistic, not a general theorem restated.

final_claim: For a self-similar symmetric sluggish continuum diffusion with alpha>0 and complete Poisson resets, the occupation fraction has a full LDP with an explicit Lamperti-dependent pole equation, rate parameterization and sharp edge exponent mu=1/(alpha+2).
limitations: The general proof uses key-renewal and Gärtner–Ellis theory, not finite numerical experiments.
Only complete memory-erasing Poisson resets in the specified continuum realization; no point-mass endpoint density or finite-time prefactor claim.
General renewal-reward rate prior-art risk remains, and public operational metadata not sanitized.
